dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Mr. Miller.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs tə ˈmiːt juː, ˈmɪstər ˈmɪlər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Call me Tom! What's your first name?
dialogue.reading: ˈkɔːl miː ˈtɑːm! ˈwʌts jʊr ˈfɜːrst ˌneɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's very long. My nickname is Nam.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈlɔːŋ. maɪ ˈnɪkneɪm ɪz ˈnɑːm.
